positions.title: Professional Services Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
Onboarding, mentorship, and leadership of an international remote team, with a focus on testing, code review & standards, Serverless architecture & microservices, full-stack integrations, and a unified CI/CD framework for development, testing, and deployment across multiple environments

Led the overhaul of essential internal tools to latest versions of Serverless, CircleCI

Architected & implemented support for unlimited environments for our internal & sitefront integrations (for development, client preview, deployment, etc.) using a simple configuration workflow (currently supports five environments)

Led effort to consolidate dozens of repositories into a few with clear workflows, testing, and monitoring standards, improving the lives of our engineers & support and multiplying productivity

positions.title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for warehouse & fulfillment integrations, major front-end integrations using event-based architecture like Redux, backend microservice design and architecture, primary technical communication to clients, mentorship of new & existing teammates

Developed npm library for promise-based FTP & SFTP file transfer, transforming complex ssh streaming methods into single lines of code for our developers; library now used in most mission-critical warehouse integrations and internal tools used for nearly all clients

Developed extensively on our Serverless automated, configurable task runner, used in production for nearly all clients for tasks such as reporting, file transfers, inventory coordination, new product catalog creation & updates, and many other automated jobs

Developed npm library for widely configurable alerting and monitoring in core server-side applications, with plugins for Graylog, Slack, SignalFX, Cloudwatch (and ability to easily create new functional logging & monitoring plugins custom to each application)

Responsible for architecting full-stack integrations, such as back-in-stock and price update notification requests (integrating Angular redux, Lambda, DynamoDB, and third-party email marketing integrations)

Overhauled our warehouse integration standards to include latest ES8 standards (including async/await, robust control flow standards, streamlined & modular codebase & file structure, development & deployment standards)

positions.title: Software Engineer  - Professional Services
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer responsible for building software integrations for large e-commerce websites

Fully integrated Pepsico’s CRM with our platform via OAuth-based API (real-time transmission of customer account creation & updates, survey responses, and transactional data for all carts, orders, and subscriptions)

Developed event-based SDK used by all new sitefront pixel and third-party integrations that supports all versions of our frontend (from original jQuery listeners to newer, Redux-based workflows used by our newer sites)

positions.title: Founder, Instructor
positions.description: I designed and built www.learnableprep.com using Wordpress, customized themes, and several plugins. I was responsible for all aspects of the business, including online & print marketing, web development, accounting, and curriculum design. I developed an SAT/ACT prep course curriculum, with an emphasis on problem solving skills, mathematics, writing & grammar, and reading comprehension, accompanied by focused assignments and practice tests. I ran full-length courses, one-on-one tutoring, and small-group sessions. Classes were held at libraries and community centers, allowing a source of revenue for important community establishments.

positions.title: Math & Science Tutor, Standardized Test Prep Specialist
SAT & ACT Instructor; SAT, ACT & LSAT Proctor

projects.title: Immedia
projects.description: Immedia is a real-time encyclopedia that blends Wikipedia with current news and social media, visualized on an beautiful, interactive timeline. Working alongside four other brilliant engineers, my roles included the layout and implementation of the timeline using D3, connecting the timeline with the preview using React, and embedding Twitter and news articles using, among other tools, Twitter's web development API. On the back-end, I was responsible for storing, ranking, and retrieving the most popular searches, and modularizing API calls. I performed server and database testing using Mocha. We also employed a uniform, consistent Git workflow to manage our code base.

projects.title: Decision Tree
projects.description:
Interactive data visualization with the ability to create, edit, move, expand/collapse, and delete nodes around a hierarchical tree graph. Perfect for organizing tasks, concepts, or other hierarchies.

❖  Tech stack: React, redux, D3.js

❖  All edits will persist on browser because the redux state is saved in local storage
